chunks: If a man is found killed, and one complete limb from his limbs is found, salat should be offered over that, and it should be buried. And if no complete limb is found for him, no salat is offered over it, and it is buried.

key_terms.قَتِيلًا: a slain person; one found killed

ai.seo_question: When is funeral salat offered for partial human remains in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning salat al-janazah and burial when only part of a slain person's body is found. It distinguishes between the presence of a complete limb, over which funeral salat is performed, and incomplete remains, which are buried without funeral salat.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.485 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

“If a man is found killed and one of his limbs is found intact, a funeral prayer should be offered over it, and it should be buried. If no complete limb is found, no funeral prayer is offered, but it should still be buried”.
